「Thank you, $$カティ$$... for letting him see Princess $$マリナ$$.」

$$カティ$$
「Don't mention it. He's achieved mutual understanding with the $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$. I can do this much to see him off on his new journey.」

「Indeed. He's just like us, after all.」

758:t_1:939.en:
$$ラッセ$$

758:t_1:940.en:
$$ミレイナ$$

758:t_1:941.en:
$$コーラサワー$$

758:t_1:942.en:
$$グラハム$$

758:t_1:945.en:
$$マリー$$
「But we'll be parting with those two for quite a while...」

758:t_1:947.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Did you say goodbye to the Princess?」

758:t_1:948.en:
$$刹那$$
「There's no need. I intend to return to Earth, no matter what.」

758:t_1:949.en:
$$刹那$$
「Even if that's decades from now.」

758:t_1:950.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Understood, $$刹那$$. I'll join you on your journey.」

758:t_1:952.en:
$$アレルヤ$$

758:t_1:953.en:
$$刹那$$

758:t_1:956.en:

758:t_1:957.en:
